description.value: Pizza 314PIE is a local pizza spot in Kamloops offering online ordering through Square, with a menu spanning classic pizzas, falafel bites, and comfort food like mac and cheese. The 'Slicery, Dicery, Everything Nicery' tagline and emphasis on supporting local give it a community-oriented character. For a touring cyclist passing through Kamloops, it offers a quick, customizable meal with the convenience of online pre-ordering.
